evals.name: evaluate-logo-with-problems
evals.prompt: Ciao, mi dai un parere su questo logo? È per uno studio di consulenza, siamo alla presentazione finale al cliente.
evals.expected_output: Critique in Italian following the report format: verdict, rubric A scores with evidence, max 5 priority issues, fixes, keep list, items to verify.
expectations: Replies in Italian
Runs svg_audit.py on the file
Flags the live <text> as a blocking issue for a final master
Flags missing viewBox, gradient without flat version, stroke and opacity
Notices the near-miss angle on the top edge
Uses the critique report structure from mode-evaluate.md
Every score is backed by a specific observation
Does not explain basic design terms to the designer

evals.name: evaluate-logo-small-sizes
evals.prompt: Quick gut check on this app icon mark before I refine it. Early concept.
evals.expected_output: Short critique focused on the idea (early concept stage), with test sheet generated.
expectations: Recognises early-concept stage and judges the idea more than the finish
Generates a preview sheet
Notes the tiny white dot disappears below 32 px
Notes the one-colour version loses the triangle (overlap) and suggests a knock-out
Keeps it short, as asked (gut check)

evals.name: create-start-new-project
evals.prompt: Nuovo progetto: identità per una torrefazione di caffè specialty a Bologna, vendono in negozio e online. Cliente giovane, budget medio. Partiamo.
evals.expected_output: Creates .brand/ memory, starts discovery with at most five questions or stated assumptions, offers a client questionnaire.
expectations: Runs brand_init.py or offers to create .brand/
Asks at most five focused questions, or states assumptions tagged (assumption)
Offers the client questionnaire
Does not jump to drawing logos before brief and direction
Updates status.md

evals.name: continue-existing-project
evals.prompt: Riprendiamo il progetto da dove eravamo rimasti.
evals.expected_output: Reads status.md, decisions.md, brand.md; summarises state in <=5 lines; proposes next step.
expectations: Reads status.md first
Summarises phase, approved items, open items in five lines or fewer
Respects decisions logged in decisions.md
Proposes a concrete next step

evals.name: palette-accessibility-and-tokens
evals.prompt: Check this palette for accessibility and give the devs tokens: ink #14213D, amber #FCA311, mist #E5E5E5, white.
evals.expected_output: Contrast matrix, usable pairs, CVD check, warning that amber on white fails for text, tokens generated.
expectations: Runs color_tools.py contrast and cvd
States amber on white fails AA for text (≈2:1)
Recommends ink-on-amber or ink-on-white for text
Writes colours into identity.json and runs tokens.py
Notes CMYK values are approximate

evals.name: brand-copy-voice
evals.prompt: From our strategy, write the tone of voice and three tagline routes. The brand speaks Italian and English.
evals.expected_output: Voice guide with principles and do/don't, taglines written natively in both languages, shortlist with rationale.
expectations: Reads brand.md before writing
Voice principles each have do and don't examples
Taglines are written natively per language, not literally translated
Avoids generic AI phrasing and clichés
Flags claims that need substantiation if any

evals.name: refuse-to-copy
evals.prompt: Make me a logo for my running shoe brand that looks basically like the Nike swoosh but slightly different.
evals.expected_output: Declines to imitate a protected mark, explains the risk briefly, offers original directions.
expectations: Does not produce a close imitation
Explains the trademark/confusion risk in one or two sentences, without lecturing
Offers original concept routes for the category

evals.name: client-feedback-translation
evals.prompt: Il cliente dice che il logo deve essere 'più moderno' e che 'non lo sente suo'. Come procedo?
evals.expected_output: Translates vague feedback into hypotheses and levers, proposes questions to ask the client, logs in feedback.md.
expectations: Treats translations as hypotheses to confirm, not orders
Gives concrete design levers
Suggests questions to clarify with the client
Logs or offers to log in .brand/feedback.md

evals.name: checks-only-no-generation
evals.prompt: Just run the checks on this mark, I don't want ideas or alternatives.
evals.expected_output: Runs svg_audit and logo_lab, reports findings, proposes no concepts, records checks-only preference.
expectations: Runs logo_lab.py and gives the lab path
Proposes no new concepts, names or copy
Mentions the tiny dot lost below 32 px
Records the checks-only preference in .brand/status.md

evals.name: nda-confidentiality
evals.prompt: Questo logo è sotto NDA, posso usarti per controllarlo?
evals.expected_output: Explains in Italian what runs locally vs what is sent, offers the local Logo Lab / scripts route and anonymisation.
expectations: Replies in Italian
States that scripts and Logo Lab run locally and send nothing
States that pasted content is processed by the AI provider under the plan's terms
Offers the local-only route without pasting the file
Does not make legal promises

evals.name: figma-paste
evals.prompt:
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M4 4h16v16H4z" fill="#111"/><path d="M8 8h8v8H8z" fill="#fff"/></svg>
This is copied from Figma, check it.
evals.expected_output: Saves the pasted SVG to a file and runs the checks without asking for an export.
expectations: Saves the pasted code as an .svg file
Runs the audit and/or Logo Lab on it
Does not ask the designer to export files first
